mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_market_regime_snapshot ( trade_date, cache_date, live_kospi, live_kosdaq, kospi_regime, kosdaq_regime, kospi_allowed_strategy, kosdaq_allowed_strategy, kospi_risk_budget, kosdaq_risk_budget, combined_regime, allowed_strategy, confidence, risk_budget, bull_score, bear_score, stress_score, breadth_ma20, breadth_ma60, volatility_20, liquidity_trend, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tradeDate}, #{cacheDate}, #{liveKospi}, #{liveKosdaq}, #{kospiRegime}, #{kosdaqRegime}, #{kospiAllowedStrategy}, #{kosdaqAllowedStrategy}, #{kospiRiskBudget}, #{kosdaqRiskBudget}, #{combinedRegime}, #{allowedStrategy}, #{confidence}, #{riskBudget}, #{bullScore}, #{bearScore}, #{stressScore}, #{breadthMa20}, #{breadthMa60}, #{volatility20}, #{liquidityTrend}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (trade_date) DO UPDATE SET cache_date = EXCLUDED.cache_date, live_kospi = EXCLUDED.live_kospi, live_kosdaq = EXCLUDED.live_kosdaq, kospi_regime = EXCLUDED.kospi_regime, kosdaq_regime = EXCLUDED.kosdaq_regime, kospi_allowed_strategy = EXCLUDED.kospi_allowed_strategy, kosdaq_allowed_strategy = EXCLUDED.kosdaq_allowed_strategy, kospi_risk_budget = EXCLUDED.kospi_risk_budget, kosdaq_risk_budget = EXCLUDED.kosdaq_risk_budget, combined_regime = EXCLUDED.combined_regime, allowed_strategy = EXCLUDED.allowed_strategy, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, risk_budget = EXCLUDED.risk_budget, bull_score = EXCLUDED.bull_score, bear_score = EXCLUDED.bear_score, stress_score = EXCLUDED.stress_score, breadth_ma20 = EXCLUDED.breadth_ma20, breadth_ma60 = EXCLUDED.breadth_ma60, volatility_20 = EXCLUDED.volatility_20, liquidity_trend = EXCLUDED.liquidity_trend, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, cache_date, live_kospi, live_kosdaq, kospi_regime, kosdaq_regime, kospi_allowed_strategy, kosdaq_allowed_strategy, kospi_risk_budget, kosdaq_risk_budget, combined_regime, allowed_strategy, confidence, risk_budget, bull_score, bear_score, stress_score, breadth_ma20, breadth_ma60, volatility_20, liquidity_trend, updated_at FROM quant_market_regime_snapshot ORDER BY trade_date DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
